title: OkeyAI joins the project list
summary:
Two community additions: an LLM playground in the project list and a guide to using Pollinations models with OpenWebUI.

The README and website now list OkeyAI API Playground under LLM Integrations, with a link to try OkeyMeta’s APIs.

The tutorial list now links to a community guide for connecting Pollinations text models to OpenWebUI.
